name: bug-bounty-report-submitter
description: Inspect live bug bounty forms or webmail with Playwright MCP, then draft and deliver self-contained, target-specific evidence-backed reports that match the discovered fields, avoid reusable template prose, and keep exact bug location, exploit path, PoC output, and attachments disciplined.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and submit bug bounty reports
interface.longDescription: Inspect a live bug bounty form or webmail UI with Playwright MCP, derive the actual delivery schema, then draft and deliver a self-contained, target-specific evidence-backed report: vulnerable function or endpoint first, root cause and exploit walkthrough next, decisive PoC output before full proof, and attachments used only as supplemental evidence or a markdown appendix when mandatory.
defaultPrompt: Draft and submit this bug bounty report through the program form
Draft this finding as a bug bounty email and send it to the specified address
Open this submission URL, write a natural report from my findings, and submit it
Turn these notes into a polished bug bounty submission and deliver it
